newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises to 563c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises to 563c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose four cents to 563 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were higher, with 19/21 microns up to one percent dearer, 20/22 microns 0.5 percent dearer and 23/24/25 microns one percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were up to 1.0 percent dearer.
Crossbreds were mixed, with 27/30 microns 0.5 percent dearer, 28/29 microns 0.5 percent cheaper and 31 micron slightly dearer.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with support from Western Europe and most sectors of the trade active.
Of 25,974 bales offered, 8.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue tomorrow in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 43,000 bales to be offered.
